newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: Turnover fell to 50,850 denars at Thursday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 176,760 denars on Tuesday as only one company traded, the exchange said.
Commercial bank Skopje shares made their debut on the third floor, selling 10 shares at 5,085 denars, above par of 5,000 denars.
Traded volume was 174 shares at the previous session on Tuesday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
